newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC Q2 loan loss provisions C$120 mln.
newsitem.headline: CIBC Q2 loan loss provisions C$120 mln.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Thursday that its second-quarter loan loss provision was C$120 million, unchanged from the year earlier period.
"The provision for credit losses held steady at C$120 million in the quarter, reflecting a full year estimate of $480 million," the bank said in a statement.
CIBC said that its net impaired loans fell almost 20 per cent to C$458 million at the end of the second quarter from C$568 million at January 31.
The ratio of net impaired loans to total loans and acceptances was 0.3 per cent at April 30, down from 0.4 per cent at January 31 and 0.8 per cent at April 30, 1996.
